shared_elements: single standing human figure filling the field
elaborate headdress or crown at top of the figure
circular disc / medallion at chest level
belt or loincloth with hanging ornaments
justification: Both are tall narrow monuments dominated by one standing figure whose head/headdress fills the upper zone, with a prominent round pectoral disc at chest height and an ornamented belt below — that vertical head-to-feet hierarchy is the most specific correspondence. The biggest differences are the frontal, heavily eroded and abstracted mass in A versus the crisp profile figure with dense side columns of rectangular sign-blocks in B, and the utterly different media (weathered stone photograph versus clean pen line drawing).
